result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with high-visibility zebra crosswalks and pedestrian signals. While basic infrastructure is present, the environment is dominated by a large number of vehicle travel lanes and lacks physical buffers or refuge islands, creating a long and exposed crossing for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross a very wide multi-lane roadway without any mid-crossing refuge or median.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the travel lanes with no physical barrier, planting strip, or furniture zone to separate pedestrians from traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip with street trees to provide a physical buffer and improve the pedestrian experience.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban sidewalk with commercial frontage adjacent to a multi-lane roadway. While the walkway provides ample space, it lacks a physical buffer from traffic and contains several fixed and temporary obstructions like utility poles and signage.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A large utility pole is positioned in the middle of the sidewalk, narrowing the effective clear path.

hazards.name: Temporary Obstruction
hazards.description: An A-frame sign is placed on the sidewalk, creating a tripping hazard and further narrowing the walkway.

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Buffer
hazards.description: Pedestrians are separated from a multi-lane, high-volume roadway only by a standard curb, with no physical buffer or planting strip.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the sidewalk along the roadway edge

interventions.title: Utility Undergrounding or Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate utility poles to a dedicated furniture zone near the curb or move utilities underground to clear the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Install a planting strip with street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions at the nearest intersection to shorten crossing distances and better define the parking lane as a buffer.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane urban arterial road with a substantial sidewalk on the left and a landscaped median. The environment is heavily oriented toward high-volume vehicle traffic, with no visible pedestrian crossing infrastructure or buffers between the walkway and the travel lanes.

hazards.name: Wide multi-lane roadway
hazards.description: The presence of at least three travel lanes in one direction encourages high vehicle speeds and creates a long, unprotected crossing distance.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right of the image

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crossings or pedestrian signals visible, forcing pedestrians to walk long distances to find a safe place to cross.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Refuge
interventions.description: Install a marked mid-block crossing utilizing the existing median as a pedestrian refuge island to break up the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes to repurpose space for a buffered bike lane or a wider sidewalk buffer, slowing traffic and improving safety.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add a row of street trees or a furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer from moving traffic.

result.summary: The environment features a wide multi-lane roadway with marked crosswalks and sidewalks on both sides. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps and street lighting is present, the long crossing distance and lack of visible pedestrian signals increase risk for people walking.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a mid-crossing refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the marked crosswalk.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Control
hazards.description: No pedestrian signals are visible at the marked crosswalk, leaving right-of-way ambiguous.
hazards.location_in_image: At the crossing point on the right side of the image.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the median to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon
interventions.description: Install signals to provide a protected crossing phase for pedestrians across this wide arterial.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Upgrade the standard transverse markings to continental style for better driver visibility.
